gb_matrix.naming: gb_a1{P|M}_b{k}{P|M}: fermionic sign, bosonic index, bosonic sign
gb_matrix.parity_note: gb parameters are treated as EVEN (commuting) formal scalars. See Issue I05 Response, section 'Parity of gb'.

inhomogeneous_deformation.convention: entries are stored for pbw_index(X) <= pbw_index(Y); gamma inherits the graded antisymmetry of the bracket: gamma(Y,X) = -(-1)^{p(X)p(Y)} gamma(X,Y)
inhomogeneous_deformation.coeff_format: linear form in the gb symbols (sympy string)

consistency.central_K_note: gamma takes values in the central extension g + C*K, not in g alone. The K-components are genuine (see Issue I05 Response) and occur exactly on (odd, even) pairs; they constrain the Layer 4 map f, which is therefore allowed to take values in g + C*K (see Issue I07).

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
